verdict.rationale: Luma documents a public API for image and video generation (Dream Machine / Luma API Platform). It has managed API access, reasoning and generation endpoints, and Python/JS/TS SDKs. Its docs are agent-friendly: a probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200, and every docs page has a markdown version. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), no independent hands-on corroboration of the official API, and no evidence that the API covers non-generation surfaces such as Agents or Skills.
